C0840.title: AI Voice Cloning Used in Executive Impersonation Scam Targeting Enterprises
C0840.summary: Reports and industry alerts show that AI voice cloning, face swapping, and other deepfake techniques have been used to impersonate acquaintances, corporate managers, or customer-service staff in fraud schemes. Attackers can extract voice or facial features from public videos, social accounts, or call snippets, then combine real-time voice conversion or forged video meetings to induce fund transfers or disclosure of sensitive information.
